Fermented for 36 hours and baked in-house daily. \
\
Behind every great loaf of sourdough is a long fermentation process, quality flour, and a seasoned starter. \
\
The process begins with our signature dough, made with organic unbleached flour and a mature sour starter.\
\
Next, we ferment the dough for 6–8 hours at room temperature before stretching, folding, and shaping it by hand.\
\
Once shaped, each loaf then undergoes a second fermentation, this time in the cold for another 30 hours, allowing the flavors to deepen.\
\
Lastly, it’s baked creating a soft, airy crumb and chewy golden crust. \
\
A versatile choice for building sandwiches, dipping into soup, or tossing in a pan to make croutons.\
\
Pick up a loaf of our sourdough bread in-store or order through the Erewhon app for home delivery.

Fried Chicken Tenders at the Café\
\
Made with Erewhon Organic Chicken and cooked in Organic Fera fruit oil for a crisp, golden finish. Each tender is garnished with organic thyme for a delicate, aromatic touch.\
\
Erewhon’s Organic Chicken is proudly raised by a four generation farm committed to creating a healthier alternative to conventional foods often containing additives and preservatives. Our chicken is Certified Humane®, free-range, antibiotic-free, Non-GMO, organic, free of preservatives and added hormones, and air-chilled.\
\
Organic Fera fruit oil is expeller-pressed from oleifera fruit grown on Regenerative Organic Certified® farms in Colombia. By using Fera for Clean-Frying® at our Cafés, we’re proud to support regenerative agriculture and the farming practices behind it.\
\
Available on select days at our Cafés and on the Erewhon App.

We’re proud to introduce Organic Fera fruit oil and clean-fried® at the Cafe. Regenerative Organic Certified® and Seed Oil Free Certified®, it delivers a light, crisp finish while supporting responsible sourcing and regenerative agriculture practices.\
\
Curious about Organic Fera fruit oil? Ask a team member in-store to learn more.

Botanically, what we call cashews are seeds, found inside a drupe, at the end of a pseudocarp, or accessory fruit, known as the cashew apple. But really, who’s thinking of botany when there are cashews to eat? \r\
•\r\
#TraderJoes 50% Less Salt Roasted & Salted Whole Cashews are just what the bag claims. They’re harvested from dwarf cashew trees, roasted to an ideal crispness in rice bran oil, and seasoned with half the salt used in our regular roasted and salted cashews.\r\
•\r\
They’re super snacks, brilliant for baking, awesome additions to a trail mix, and a smart way to boost your smoothie. Add them to hot or cold breakfast cereal. Stir fry them with chicken and veggies. \r\
—\r\
• Kosher (pareve) • Product of Vietnam, India, & Thailand • Every day •

🥑#TraderJoes Avocado’s Number Guacamole is making its return to our refrigerators with an even tastier recipe, now conveniently packaged in a tub, rather than two trays. \r\
•\rin 1811, Lorenzo Avogadro published an essay hypothesizing that the number of molecules within an equal volume of any number of gases, under ideal temperature and pressure conditions, would be the same. This breakthrough would lead to the conceptualization of the “mole,” a way to standardize the quantification of matter: 6.02214076 x 10^23 particles of any given substance. Avogadro didn’t live long enough to learn this number, but his initial theory was so impactful that the number was named for him. We also like to think he had a hand in helping us determine how many hass avocados fit in a “Mole”—guacamole, that is. \r•\
While it’s a natural fit for tortilla chips, we find that Avocado’s Number Guacamole is also a winning spread on a burger, a booster for a BLT, and a top choice for easy avocado toasts.\r\
—\r\
• Kosher (pareve) • Mexico • Every Day •

Here’s an unexpected twist on a Customer favorite cheese: #TraderJoes Unexpected Broccoli Cheddar Soup! This smooth, creamy, and savory soup is packed with chunks of tender broccoli and a slight Parmesan-esque edge from our Hall of Fame classic Unexpected Cheddar.\r\
•\r\
Excellent as an entrée and spectacular as a side, our \r\
Unexpected Broccoli Cheddar Soup makes a particularly great pairing option for a hearty sandwich or crisp, leafy green salad. We also like serving it simply with a hunk of crusty bread for dipping or hollowing out a Sourdough Boule and enjoying it inside a bread bowl.\r\
—\r\
• Ready in minutes • Cheese made with microbial enzymes •Every day •

📸: “Alfred-oh Yes Butternut Squash Lasagna,” feat. Trader Joe’s No Boil Italian Lasagna Noodles • Tap the link in our bio to get this tasty #TJsRecipe\r\
—\
#TraderJoes Italian Lasagna Noodles come to us from a longtime Italian pasta supplier, and are made with the finest durum semolina wheat. What makes these noodles extra special is their “no-boil” cooking method—unlike most dry pastas, you can place these lasagna noodles into your casserole dish straight from the package, with a generous coating of sauce, and they will cook to the ideal tender-chewy texture that makes lasagna memorable. \r\
•\r\
This recipe features half moon-shaped slices of butternut squash layered throughout. It makes a delightfully fall flavored #lasagna, with considerably less effort than you’d expend using standard lasagna noodles. \r\
—\r\
• Kosher (pareve) • Limited • Italy •

Resembling something like a miniature, folded-up croissant cake, #TraderJoes Kouign Amann are made with luxurious layers of dough that are carefully laminated with butter & sugar, and slowly baked to create a captivating caramelized flavor and phenomenally flaky texture.\r\
•\
While wonderfully delicious, it perhaps goes without saying that they can be rather challenging to make at home, and freshly-baked Kouign Amann can be difficult to come by. Each box of Trader Joe’s Kouign Amann comes with four frozen pastries—all you need to do is allow pastries to proof (aka, let them rise at room temperature, per package instructions), bake, and enjoy with your morning coffee or tea! \r\
—\r\
• Kosher (dairy) • In our freezers • Limited •

🫖London calling! #TraderJoes London Fog Tea Concentrate, that is. This 2:1 sweetened tea concentrate is inspired by a classic Earl Grey, made with a blend of brisk, earthy black teas and flavored with bergamot, lemon, and a touch of vanilla.\r\
•\r\
Mix one part concentrate with two parts milk or non-dairy beverage to create your own café-worthy beverage. Each bottle can produce up to four excellent hot or iced drinks, ready for smooth sipping whenever you’re in need of a caffeinated pick-me-up!\r\
—\r\
• Kosher (pareve) • Every Day •
